name: Luxus Hunza Attabad Lake Resort
highlight: 5-star resort perched directly over turquoise Attabad Lake
season: closes in winter  -  listed closed approx 21 Sep 2025 to 28 Feb 2026 (dates shift yearly; confirm directly)
pros: Unmatched lakefront setting and views
Strong cleanliness and staff-attentiveness scores
Full facilities: restaurant, garden, terrace, activities
cons: Recurring complaints of sewage/thin-wall noise in some rooms
Environmental criticism over waste handling near the lake
take: The signature lakeside splurge in Hunza and genuinely well-rated (9.0/361), but book upper/newer rooms and note it shuts for winter.

name: Hunza Serena Hotel
highlight: Region's first 5-star; panorama of Rakaposhi, Ultar, Lady Finger, Diran, Golden Peak
pros: Best-in-class service and five-peak views
Modern amenities, reliable comfort
Central Karimabad location
cons: Weak/unstable WiFi noted repeatedly
Kitchen smells reported in corridors
take: The safe upscale choice with the most consistent service in the valley; also ~4/5 on Tripadvisor. Priciest in Karimabad but reliable.

name: Serena Altit Fort Residence
highlight: Heritage rooms + luxury tents inside the royal garden of 11th-century Altit Fort
pros: Arguably the best location in Hunza, inside the historic fort garden
Authentic heritage build with hand-woven textiles/woodwork
Complimentary Altit Fort tours; highly praised staff
cons: Only ~5 rooms/tents, books out fast
Premium pricing for limited inventory
take: Highest-rated stay in the valley (9.7). A boutique heritage experience rather than a full-service hotel  -  book well ahead.

name: Eagle's Nest Hotel
highlight: Duikar clifftop viewpoint (~10,000 ft) over 11 peaks incl. Rakaposhi & Lady Finger
season: likely closes or limited access in deep winter (high-altitude jeep road to Duikar); confirm directly
pros: Widely called the best sunrise/sunset viewpoint in Hunza
Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice, ranked #3 of 17 in Hunza
Clean rooms, cooperative family-run staff
cons: 6 km jeep road above Karimabad; not walkable to bazaar
Rooms are simpler than the price/reputation implies
take: You pay for the view, and it delivers. Go for one or two nights for the sunrise; less ideal as a base for exploring the bazaar.

name: Hunza Embassy Hotel
highlight: Terrace valley views, walkable to Karimabad bazaar; new pool/spa being built
pros: Great terrace views and central, walkable location
Owner/staff repeatedly praised as helpful
Good on-site food
cons: Cleanliness and maintenance flagged in recent reviews
Intermittent WiFi; some rooms dark
take: Decent mid-range value for location and views, but quality is inconsistent  -  inspect the room first. Ranked mid-pack (#10 of 16).

name: Baltit Heritage Inn
highlight: Cozy heritage-style inn moments from Baltit Fort with mountain views
pros: Clean, quiet, cosy rooms with mountain views
Excellent, accommodating owner/staff
Steps from Baltit Fort and restaurants
cons: Very thin review base (only ~2 TA reviews)  -  hard to corroborate at scale
Unstable electricity/WiFi (area-wide issue)
take: Charming small heritage inn with strong anecdotal praise, but the review sample is tiny  -  treat rating as indicative only.

name: Old Hunza Inn
highlight: Backpacker favourite (now 'Backpackers Stories by Old Hunza Inn') with valley-view lounge
pros: Among the cheapest clean beds in Karimabad; strong value
Social lounge/terrace over the valley, good for meeting travellers
Hot showers, shared kitchen, 24h desk (English/Urdu/Chinese/Japanese)
cons: Basic, simple rooms
No single consolidated rating source to cite reliably
take: The go-to backpacker/budget pick, rebranded 'Backpackers Stories.' Overwhelmingly positive anecdotal reviews; couldn't pin one authoritative numeric rating.

name: Hunza Marcopolo Inn
highlight: 40-year-old Gulmit inn near Attabad Lake & Passu Cones with fruit garden
season: usable in winter but no running water in bathrooms (bucket service)  -  best in summer
pros: #1 of 6 lodgings in Gulmit; friendly staff, clean, 24h hot water in season
Peaceful setting with organic garden produce
Best base for Attabad Lake / Passu day trips
cons: A price-quoting dispute reported (confirm rate in writing before arrival)
Winter: no running bathroom water; some 'shabby/ill-maintained' comments
take: The strongest Gulmit option and fine value in summer; verify the nightly rate up front and skip it midwinter.

name: Passu Tourist Lodge
highlight: Quiet KKH lodge under the Passu Cones, open all winter
season: year-round  -  explicitly stays open in winter when most Passu/Gulmit hotels close
pros: Rare genuinely year-round property in upper Gojal
Highest TA rating in this set (4.5/5); friendly English-speaking staff
Calm, isolated setting with Passu Cones views; occasional local music nights
cons: Only 12 rooms; small review base
Remote  -  limited dining/services nearby off-season
take: Best base for the Passu Cones/Hussaini bridge and the reliable winter choice in Gojal. Small but consistently well-liked.

name: Roomy Daastaan Hotel
highlight: Modern Karimabad hotel with a large panoramic terrace over the valley
pros: Well-rated newer option (8.7 Booking; #2 of 20 specialty lodging, 4/5 TA)
Big terrace with 'surreal' mountain views
Family-style, highly rated service (staff named in reviews)
cons: Occasional maintenance/cleanliness notes
Part of a chain  -  less local character than heritage inns
take: Added as the strongest missing option: a dependable modern mid-range with a standout terrace, well-corroborated across Booking and Tripadvisor.
